sources.title: ReLoop demo reuse rules
sources.text: A human must inspect condition, specifications and ownership permission before a transfer. For a monitor, check connectors, power supply and electrical safety with qualified staff. The assistant cannot certify safety or approve a transfer. A user records an inspected demo transfer through the existing review form.

sources.title: ReLoop responsible AI guidance
sources.text: The agent may search inventory, retrieve guidance and estimate a reuse proposal. It has no transfer, purchase, email, shell or file-writing tool. Human inspection and an explicit confirmation in the normal transfer form are required to change stock.

[reuse_rules-3] A human must inspect condition, specifications and ownership permission before a transfer. For a monitor, check connectors, power supply and electrical safety with qualified staff. The assistant cannot certify safety or approve a transfer. A user records an inspected demo transfer through the existing review form.

[responsible_ai-4] The agent may search inventory, retrieve guidance and estimate a reuse proposal. It has no transfer, purchase, email, shell or file-writing tool. Human inspection and an explicit confirmation in the normal transfer form are required to change stock.
